{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "satisfaction_score",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "taste_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear ordinal categories (excellent/good/acceptable/poor) describing a specific product attribute; well-separated and segmentable against satisfaction."
    },
    {
      "name": "product_quality_assessment",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A generic overall quality assessment is essentially a proxy/restatement of satisfaction itself rather than an external product attribute, so it risks trivial correlation."
    },
    {
      "name": "freshness_delivery_condition",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable categories (fresh/damaged/stale) capturing a distinct delivery/condition attribute; segmentable, though ~39% NULL weakens coverage."
    },
    {
      "name": "ingredient_quality_naturalness",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct attribute about naturalness/health concerns with well-separated categories that can be compared against satisfaction."
    },
    {
      "name": "value_for_money_perception",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Price-value dimension with clear ordered categories; a classic, interpretable driver to segment satisfaction on and distinct from the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "product_consistency_reliability",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Consistency/reliability attribute with graded categories; interpretable and distinct from overall satisfaction."
    },
    {
      "name": "competitive_product_standing",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Relative positioning against competitors with clear categories; an external associational variable segmentable against satisfaction."
    },
    {
      "name": "repeat_purchase_intent",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Repeat-purchase intent is an outcome/consequence of satisfaction, not a product attribute; correlating it with satisfaction is near-tautological rather than explanatory."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are genuine, interpretable product-attribute dimensions (taste, freshness, ingredients, value, consistency, competitive standing) with well-separated categorical scales that a human can segment on and compare against satisfaction, directly serving the query about attributes associated with satisfaction. Two columns weaken the set: product_quality_assessment is an overall quality proxy that largely restates satisfaction, and repeat_purchase_intent is a downstream outcome rather than an attribute, so both invite trivial/tautological correlations. Some columns carry substantial NULL rates (freshness ~39%, value/ingredients/consistency ~10-15%), reducing comparison power but not eliminating it. Overall this is a strong, human-interpretable EDA schema with a couple of restatement-type inclusions."
}
